events.name: Indianapolis Colts at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady reached 500 touchdown passes for his unparalleled career and the New England Patriots put together their second straight win after a mediocre start to the season, beating Indianapolis 38-24 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady reaches 500 TD passes in Patriots' 38-24 win

headlines.description: Stephen Hauschka hit a 46-yard field goal as time expired, lifting the Buffalo Bills to a 13-12 win over the Tennessee Titans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills beat Titans 13-12 on Hauschka's 46-yard field goal

headlines.description: Michael Johnson returned an interception for the tying score, and Sam Hubbard went 19 yards with a fumble for the clinching touchdown Sunday, rallying the Cincinnati Bengals from a 17-point deficit to a 27-17 victory over the Miami Dolphins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals score 27 straight points for 27-17 win over Dolphins

headlines.description: Rookie Greg Joseph's 37-yard field goal -- a knuckleball that barely cleared the crossbar -- with two seconds left in overtime gave the Cleveland Browns a 12-9 win over the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns edge Ravens 12-9 in overtime on knuckleball FG

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw two touchdown passes and LeGarrette Blount ran for two scores, lifting the Detroit Lions to a 31-23 win over the Green Bay Packers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions take advantage of mistakes in 31-23 win over Packers

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Turns out the Kansas City Chiefs can play a little defense, too.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs get pick-6, march all over Jags in soggy 30-14 romp

events.name: Denver Broncos at New York Jets

headlines.shortLinkText: Crowell, big-play Jets romp past Broncos 34-16

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger and Antonio Brown connected on two second-half touchdowns, and the Pittsburgh Steelers pulled away from the Atlanta Falcons for a 41-17 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brown scores twice, Steelers roll past reeling Falcons 41-17

events.name: New York Giants at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Graham Gano connected on a career-long 63-yard field goal with 1 second remaining to lift the Carolina Panthers to a wild 33-31 victory over the New York Giants on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gano's 63-yard field goal lifts Panthers over Giants 33-31

events.name: Oakland Raiders at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw for 339 yards and two touchdowns, leading the Los Angeles Chargers to a 26-10 victory over the Oakland Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers throws for 339 yards, 2 TDs as Chargers beat Raiders

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw for 301 yards and one touchdown, Linval Joseph returned a fumble 64 yards for a score and the Minnesota Vikings beat the Philadelphia Eagles 23-21 Sunday in a rematch of last season's NFC championship game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins, defense lead Vikings over Eagles 23-21

headlines.description: Josh Rosen threw a 75-yard touchdown pass to fellow rookie Christian Kirk on Arizona's first play from scrimmage and the Cardinals used five takeaways to get their first win by beating the San Francisco 49ers 28-18 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals beat 49ers 28-18 for 1st win of season

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Todd Gurley rushed for three touchdowns, Jared Goff passed for 321 yards and a score , and the Los Angeles Rams remained unbeaten by holding off the Seattle Seahawks 33-31 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gurley's 3 TDs keep Rams perfect in 33-31 win over Seahawks

headlines.description: DeAndre Hopkins had 151 yards receiving, including a key reception in overtime, and Ka'imi Fairbairn's 36-yard field goal lifted the Houston Texans to a 19-16 win over the Dallas Cowboys on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fairbairn's FG in OT lifts Texans over Cowboys 19-16

events.name: Washington Redskins at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees' 62-yard touchdown pass to rookie Tre'Quan Smith made him the NFL's all-time leader in yards passing and sent the New Orleans Saints well on their way to a lopsided 43-19 victory over the mistake-prone Washington Redskins on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees makes history in style, Saints thrash Redskins 43-19
